preCaptureCorrections.reason: Already-consumed settled control descriptors show every mandatory cross-pose transition exceeds the frozen repeat-noise RMS cutoff but does not exceed the structural anatomical-novelty cutoff. Structural novelty is not required to prove that a frame is no longer the previous pose; this correction was frozen before any Prompt 2 Unity outcome.
preCaptureCorrections.rule: Cross-pose stale-frame rejection requires RMS128 above the frozen repeat-noise cutoff; structural distance is reported diagnostically and is not used to claim anatomical novelty. Within-pose accepted stability still requires both RMS and structural distances within their frozen limits.

preCaptureCorrections.reason: Discarded stale captures must be retained and may exactly duplicate a prior pose image; global hash uniqueness would reject the diagnostic evidence the task requires.
preCaptureCorrections.rule: Exact duplicate hashes are forbidden among accepted scientific captures. Discarded captures remain hash-verified and indexed but may duplicate another record and never satisfy a gate or readiness count.

preCaptureCorrections.reason: Pre-capture code review found that ordinal rollback attempts could be relabeled as rejected, incomplete and rollback without demonstrating the corresponding actuator semantics.
preCaptureCorrections.rule: The auditor derives directional/observe class from plannedAction and executedAction, rejected from actionAccepted=false, incomplete only from actionAccepted=true plus actionCompleted=false, and rollback from rollbackAttempted=true. Rollback may overlap either actuator outcome, but a category string or ordinal attempt number cannot create evidence and overlap cannot inflate later independent/readiness counts. Actual producer/aggregator counts must be recorded rather than constants.

preCaptureCorrections.reason: Final pre-capture cross-review found that pooling every record in a movement category compares stable repeats from different physical visits, while a contact-restored flag alone does not prove rollback pose restoration.
preCaptureCorrections.rule: Audit freshness/stability within each visitId, require every factual visit assigned to a required category to pass, and never compare accepted repeat stability across different poses. A rollback also requires the recorded resulting position and rotation to return within the frozen 0.25 mm and 0.25 degree movement tolerance of its recorded pre-action pose.

preCaptureCorrections.reason: A pre-outcome failed engineering run proved the POC scene has zero active USImageAggregator components (the serialized aggregator GameObject is inactive with a three-frame setting), while CaptureCleanImage renders the camera from the direct UltrasoundManager producer texture. Requiring one active five-sample aggregator would reject the real clean capture path and caused the runner to remain alive without sealing an outcome.
preCaptureCorrections.rule: Use explicit DIRECT_PRODUCER_CAMERA mode. Require exactly zero active aggregators, at least one explicit successful producer publication for every accepted capture, matching pose epoch, a strictly later producer frame and monotonically increasing producer scan serial. Retain and discard both immediate_post_pose and published_warmup images. Aggregator history fields cannot satisfy or block this direct-producer gate.

oldR6Evidence.role: immutable diagnostic only; old candidate image-pose pairs are forbidden for training or basin inference

producerPoseHandshake.rootCauseModel: CaptureCleanImage Camera.Render/ReadPixels is only a consumer; its pixels are produced by UltrasoundManager Update/explicit PublishCurrentPose -> Scan -> Texture2D.Apply. The POC scene aggregator GameObject is inactive and is not part of this clean camera capture path.
requirements: producerUnityFrame is strictly later than poseAppliedUnityFrame
producerSamplesPublished is at least 1 and producerScanSerial increases between accepted slots
unityFrameCount is not earlier than producerUnityFrame
acquisitionOrder and unityFrameCount increase within each pose visit
both immediate_post_pose and published_warmup images are explicitly retained as discarded before accepted captures
forbiddenEvidence: an arbitrary wall-clock delay without producer-frame identity
two identical frames without pose-epoch provenance
inactive aggregator state presented as active freshness evidence
a score computed from new anatomy labels paired with old pixels

repeatNoise.representation: clean ultrasound grayscale bilinear 128x128 in [0,1] plus 4x4x8 unsigned gradient-orientation histogram
repeatNoise.previousPoseRejection: The first accepted capture at a new control must exceed the frozen repeat-noise RMS cutoff from the prior pose's final accepted capture. Structural distance remains diagnostic and cannot establish anatomical novelty here.

movementFreshnessGate.rejectedDefinition: actionAccepted=false, derived from flags rather than category string
movementFreshnessGate.incompleteDefinition: actionAccepted=true and actionCompleted=false, derived from flags rather than category string and distinct from rejection
movementFreshnessGate.rollbackDefinition: rollbackAttempted=true; may overlap rejected or incomplete but is not inferred from ordinal attempt number
movementFreshnessGate.categoryAggregation: per visitId; every factual visit in a required category must pass and cross-pose repeat stability comparisons are forbidden

gate.rule: PASS only when immutable snapshot integrity, all producer-pose handshakes, positive-control requirements and every movement category pass. Missing/unknown/mutable evidence fails closed.
